claims.statement: Full FEI is equivalent to a uniform bound on the expected U per expected influence at the single half-restriction scale, only for finite-dimensional H/I maximizers. CHR_U(K) implies C_FEI <= 2+2K+2/ln2.
claims.scope: Genuine Boolean functions, uniform cube, bits, physical half restrictions, maximizers c_n.
claims.unpaid_statement: Existence of an absolute K in CHR_U(K).
